task: classify bags of 10 chromosome-6 traces as untreated or CTCF-depleted

evaluation.split: random 70/15/15 trace split stratified by condition and run group

limitations: Locus-specific missingness is not controlled in this preliminary run.
Run groups are stratified across partitions rather than held out.
Multiple traces from one biological cell may not be group-split when cell identifiers are unavailable.
